# TPC-DI A1

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcdi
```

> [TPC-DI](../../tpc-di.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DI queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  c.Tier,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.SK_CustomerID) AS customer_count,
  COUNT(t.TradeID) AS trade_count,
  SUM(t.Quantity * t.TradePrice) AS total_value,
  AVG(t.TradePrice) AS avg_trade_price
FROM DimCustomer AS c
LEFT JOIN FactTrade AS t
  ON c.SK_CustomerID = t.SK_CustomerID
WHERE
  c.IsCurrent IS TRUE
GROUP BY
  c.Tier
ORDER BY
  c.Tier
```
